reverse_orphan_checks: Reusable Product Line identity is Customer-neutral and never owns global SLA authority; every authoritative classification resolves one active Customer-compatible Contract Product Line and its current immutable policy revision.

Every authoritative LLD-06 command has one exact traceability edge proving transaction boundary, revision effects, audit policy, stable errors, concrete tests and COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 or the exact shared outer-command equivalent.
Every LLD-06 query has deterministic ordering, bounded point semantics or cursor/batch streaming, explicit supporting index evidence and concrete acceptance/failure tests.
Advanced Search Product remains discarded and cannot participate in mapping, classification, SLA calculation, cohort identity or report evidence.
Effective SLA elapsed time is exact max(0, endpoint - accepted Report Date - accepted cumulative source-reported suspension); missing Report Date stays uncalculable and suspension is never inferred.
Canonical cohort month is fixed America/Guayaquil and partitioned by Customer, Contract, CPL, severity and policy tier; Objective timezone never changes cohort membership or report-period authority.
Daily/Weekly/selected-range output is an as-of progress view over canonical monthly cohorts and does not redefine contractual cohort boundaries.

Report staging is technical until artifact verification plus CompleteSlaReport atomically publishes immutable CompletedReportEvidence; failed/cancelled attempts retain bounded metadata only and never authorize operational cleanup.
The XLSX writer reads sealed snapshot rows only, performs no live-domain query, and uses temporary-file plus verified atomic finalization semantics without silently overwriting unrelated artifacts.
